DTR SPEECH FUNCTIONS ELPAC Level 2 · Lexile 1000–1300L

Four Panels Before Four

Ask four people. Record what you would say.

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The poster

As you record, the four parts fill in. Match each old part to its new part to see what changed.

“DO NOT LOOK BACK”OLD RULE
SHE TURNS TO STONEOLD END
“DO NOT LOOK BACK”NEW RULE
SHE LOOKS BACK, THEN WALKS ONNEW END
THE OLD STORYTHE NEW BOOK

THE SCENE

You are making the poster for Reading Night. Your class read an old story, and then a new book. The new book follows the same path as the old story. Your poster must show the two next to each other. You are alone at the poster table. Four people each know one part.

THE HISTORY

Your poster is made like a Hmong story cloth. Hmong families left Laos in the 1970s. Women made pictures on cloth with thread. Each picture showed one part of the journey, in order.
